This is the complete unchanged allocation input from the third native study
frame of the synthetic `cash-heavy-hour` ACCOUNT scenario, captured by the actual
service HTTP scientific pipeline. It is test evidence, not market or account
qualification evidence. The captured original method has no numerical-output
opt-in and must retain its strict `POST_SOLVE_CONSTRAINT_REJECTED` result.

The regression opts into `VALIDATED_FEASIBLE_SEGMENT_V1` explicitly, preserving
the original NAV, forecasts, all 7,141 return observations, current weights,
fees, constraints and solver settings. Its scalar independent oracle checks
the exact original-NAV funded boundary and recomputes the sample-variance
objective. No target or forecast was fitted to the corrected output.
